prompts.name: Квіти й свічка (жіноче)
prompts.prompt: Create an elegant birthday greeting background: a generous bouquet of peonies and roses mixed with {{SEASONAL_BOTANICALS}}, a small burning candle and a gift box tied with a silk ribbon on a wooden table. Soft pink, peach and golden palette with a touch of {{SEASON_PALETTE}}, warm glow, gentle bokeh lights, delicate and festive; add {{CREATIVE_ANCHOR}} as a small personal detail. For a Ukrainian Telegram birthday greeting on {{DATE_ISO}}; its mood is {{DAY_THEME}}. Produce a single 16:9 landscape image, intended for 1280×720. Keep the central 50% calm and low in detail for a name and a short greeting added later in code, NOT by the image model. No text, numbers, letters, captions, lettering on objects, watermark, logos, people, recognizable faces, or copyrighted characters. No garish neon, busy edge clutter, or visual noise. Avoid these recent visual combinations: {{RECENT_VISUALS}}.
